## Summary
The context/memory plane lands as a new `hh-context` crate — the context
builder with its six reserved slots and kernel floors, the policy engine
(`default` landed; the registration contract refuses undeclared
inputs/debt), and the C0 `MemoryStore` with scope-lease fencing,
deterministic retrieval over `lexical_index`, and the E1–E4 lifecycle
algebra.

- **`hh-context::{codec,vocab}`** — strict closed-record JSON helpers
  and the closed sums: `CandidateKind`, `Retention{required|optional}`,
  the kernel-fixed `PriorityClass` eviction order, `CacheTier`,
  `OmissionReason`, `Revalidation`, `ValidityPolicy`, the
  `RetrievalQuery` closed sum, `Memory`/`Artifact` records
  (`MemoryContent::Text` reuses `hh-hir`'s one prose leaf — CC7).
- **`hh-context::plan`** — `Layout`/`SlotDeclaration`/`Reservation`/
  `ContextPlan`; the six reserved slots `{kernel, definition, principal,
  transcript, external, unverified}` at floors `{kernel, definition,
  principal, delegate, external, unverified}` and tiers `{static, static,
  dynamic, transcript, dynamic, dynamic}`; `link_layout` refuses a
  missing reserved slot, a lowered floor, a never-admissible
  `admitted_state`, `transcript_item` outside the `transcript` tier
  (LC-1) and a volatile kind in a `static` slot (LC-3) — AC-R-2.4.1-14.
- **`hh-context::policy`** — the `ContextPolicy` contract,
  `PolicyDeclaration` + `check` (undeclared inputs / missing debt
  records refuse registration — AC-R-2.4.1-11 / AC-R-2.4.2-6), and the
  `default` no-widen policy.
- **`hh-context::assemble`** — one deterministic pass `admit → reserve →
  select → enforce_budget → check_invariants → plan`. Policies narrow
  only: a widened `(candidate, slot)` pair or a dropped `required`
  candidate is `PolicyViolation` and **no plan is minted**
  (AC-R-2.4.1-4). Optional eviction follows the `PriorityClass`
  declaration order with `(candidate_id)` tie-break; required overflow
  is `ContextWindowExceeded` → `stop` at Stage 0/1 (AC-R-2.4.1-6).
  `plan_id = idp("context_plan", canonical(plan))` — identical inputs
  mint identical ids and the estimator's identity is an input
  (AC-R-2.4.1-8).
- **`hh-context::memory`** — `MemoryStore` with the C0 ops
  `put`/`bind`/`revoke`/`resolve`/`manifest`/`enumerate`/
  `stale_candidates`; the `put` order `provenance → scope → contract →
  label → lease → supersession → conflict → store`; scope leases with
  generation fencing (`Fenced`); delegate/text write ceilings; the
  deterministic conflict detector (`conflict_set_ref` is the audit
  partition's one content ref); `resolve(execute)` never serves
  revoked/superseded/expired heads (AC-R-2.4.3-2/-5).
- **`hh-context::lifecycle`** — the E1–E4 pure functions:
  `lifecycle_state` (`revoked > superseded > expired >
  stale_by_dependency > {valid|unknown}` — `unknown` when nothing is
  checkable, never silently valid), `check_contract`,
  `filter_for_slot` (`validity → authority → readers` — the attested
  order), `write` (the `put` order), plus `promote` (human/kernel
  reviewer, `security.label.endorsed{basis: promotion}`, the endorsed
  supersession path), `revalidate`, `resolve_conflict`; transitive
  stale-by-dependency through `justifications`.
- **`hh-context::retrieve`** — `enumerate` over `lexical_index`
  (`by_address`/`by_name`/`by_path_glob`/`by_run`/`lexical`), the
  `deterministic_default` ranker, the `RetrievalBudget{tokens,k}` cut
  (nothing silently dropped — `withheld[]{reason}` accounts), the
  `context.memory.read` audit row + `context.retrieval.completed`
  report; a request watermark past `applied_seq` is `StaleStore`.
- **`hh-context::events`** — payload builders for `context.assembled`
  (`assembly_ms{measured_at}` = M5), `context.artefact.delivered`/
  `activated`, `context.retrieval.completed`, `context.memory.*`,
  `security.label.endorsed` over an `EventSink` port — the kernel
  computes payloads; the caller owns `append` (I-PROV).
- **`hh-ledger`** — `context.assembled`, `context.artefact.activated`,
  `context.retrieval.completed` registered as durable
  provenance-mandatory non-audit rows (ADR-0066 d2 / ADR-0079 d8);
  `ViewKind::{LexicalIndex, MemoryStaleIndex, MemoryUsage}` added
  (owner-projected — `Store::project` refuses them in-crate).
- **`hh-identity`** — `RecordKind::{Memory, MemoryManifest}` with domain
  tags + semantic projection.
- **`hh-telemetry`** — the `pending_classes_are_declared_not_violations`
  test re-pointed to `verification.artefact.followed` (still
  Stage-3-pending) now that `context.artefact.activated` resolves.
